title: Cryptic Hive Ritual
description: A robed insectoid figure with a gas mask and halo sits atop a mound of dark soil or coal, holding a staff with an ornate key-like symbol. Hooded cultist figures with blank faces kneel in a circle around the mound, some holding small objects, as rings and smoke rise in a cavernous setting with stalactites and floating orbs.
prompt: A detailed black and white ink drawing of a large robed insectoid creature wearing a gas mask and golden halo, seated on a mound of dark earth inside a cavern. It holds a staff topped with a circular key symbol. Around the base, multiple hooded cultists with blank mask faces kneel in a ritual circle, some handling small objects and rings. Stalactites hang from the ceiling with floating orbs and smoke, in a surreal occult atmosphere.
